name: Ebana Keito
source:
[i]"You're too carefree. Are you dumb or something?"[/i]

Although he seems like a serious person, he's got a mouth on him and always gets into arguments. However, similar to Dazai, he's very grounded. A skillful cook. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch5]Idea Factory International[/url]]
